$comment: AUTHORITY for the headers the gateway puts on every response it sends (TRANSPORT-HTTP.md § Every response): on every route, whatever its status, a success, an error, bytes and a stream alike. `every` is each header every response carries, with its value, exactly: the security headers, and CORS that is open to every origin. `requestId` is the header that names the request: a new UUID for each request, in lower case with hyphens, which each line the gateway logs while it answers the request carries as its `requestId` (service-telemetry/log-lines.json). `absent` is each header no response carries: the API is bearer-only, so no origin can ride a browser's ambient credentials. `preflight` is how the gateway answers an `OPTIONS` request, before it routes it and whatever its path: with its `status` and no body, every header of `every` and `requestId`, each of its `headers`, and, when the request carries the header an `echoes` entry names, that entry's header with the request header's value, and then a `Vary` of `vary`.

every.name: Permissions-Policy
every.value: camera=(), geolocation=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
